annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because its description invites viewers to join OneCoin, and its walkthrough tells users how to complete the account and upload documents so they can trade the purported coin. The U.S. Department of Justice documents OneCoin as a fraudulent cryptocurrency-selling operation. The passport, address and bank-detail steps are presented as platform KYC, not as evidence that the uploader asks viewers to surrender existing passwords or recovery phrases.
